title: SpaceBuildCreate
description: space.build-create@1: the body of POST /api/v1/spaces, the agent asking Space for a new space of its own (OpenVibe.Space's builder API; plan 2026-10-22 §Z stage Z1). It answers space.build-list@1 ({ space }). The name and the description are what the space shows; the space is made from Space's blank template and the agent fills its files.

description.description: What the space does, in a line.
